checks.detail: Every supported stable source family and every built-in texture/audio preset has deterministic catalog coverage.
Dependency cycle is deterministic and explicit.
Duplicate source hashes are grouped deterministically.
Runtime inclusion closes over downloadable dependencies.
Key order cannot change an importer settings hash.
Atlas output is independent of input enumeration order.
Grid and connected-alpha automatic slicing return bounded deterministic regions.
CJK, RTL, combining, and emoji gaps include actions.
Traversal, corrupt magic, SVG active content, and external resources are rejected.
Interrupted folder moves roll back; successful moves preserve both GUIDs.
512×512 deterministic storage and 256 chunk boundaries completed in 47.45ms.
Import comparison identifies only changed provenance fields.
A failed reimport restores the exact last verified artifact without a silent substitute.
